purpose: Define the minimum typed review surface for MTO and OTM without authorizing equivalence, substitution, promotion, or theorem status.

candidate_types.meaning: An irreducible computational element admitted by the proposal.
A transient computational organization of primitives that may also be represented or inspected analytically as a condition. It has no persistent identity after a resolved closure.
A finite, ordered or otherwise structured collection of admissible aspects that satisfies a future admissibility predicate.
An RT object treated as the result domain of a candidate closure operation; this does not redefine existing RT authority.
The OTM result carrier. Set, multiset, sequence, and residue-bearing collection remain alternatives.

admissibility.note: No lawful-organization predicate is adopted by this report.

mto_candidate_relation.reason: A candidate-set form avoids assuming single-valued resolution before selection and tie-breaking are defined.

constraints: must not reconstruct historical aspect organizations

typed_failure_semantics.condition: Input is not a lawful aspect organization.
Multiple RT candidates exist without a canonical selector.
A resolved RT is supplied where an aspect organization is required.
A non-resolved object is supplied to OTM.
Primitive collection carrier is not determined.
An attempt is made to recover historical aspect organizations.

identity_boundaries: Primitive reference identity is distinct from aspect organization identity.
Aspect identity may be transient, but this does not erase primitive source identity.
RT identity and residue/source identity must not be discarded by MTO without a separate preservation rule.
Equal MTO candidates or outputs do not authorize substitution in unrelated operators.

user_clarification.statement: Aspect is computational: 2+2 can be an aspect. Aspect can also be used in analysis as a condition, and can also be an aspect.
user_clarification.interpretation: Computational and analytical readings are dual governed views of one provisional Aspect object, not mutually exclusive ontologies.

open_obligations: Define the lawful aspect organization carrier.
Define the admissibility predicate and its context.
Choose set, multiset, sequence, or residue-bearing carrier for OTM output.
Define MTO candidate equality versus RT identity.
Define deterministic MTO selection or retain candidate-set semantics.
Specify provenance and residue preservation through both directions.
Test compatibility with existing RT higher-order aspect participation.
nonclaims: No MTO or OTM operator has been added to canonical mathematics.
No equivalence relation has been authorized.
No deterministic executable calculus has been established.
No theorem, physical interpretation, or promotion decision follows.
next_action: Resolve the lawful organization carrier and OTM output carrier before defining any deterministic MTO selector.
